scope: Typed actual-app acceptance scenarios; not evidence of sensors or physical action
evaluation: Read actual replies and inspect goal/progress state. Record first useful reply latency. Repeat with paraphrases; keywords alone are insufficient.

messages: The fridge door is open now. What changed?
criteria: Explicitly contrast closed before with open now

messages: I changed my mind. Help me find my backpack instead.
criteria: Ask relevant missing detail if no observation exists
Cancel clears goal and pending step
No claim of search without actual result

messages: I last left it on the sofa.
criteria: Use last-reported location as historical report
Do not invent current location or directions
Recognize reported completion without claiming sensor confirmation

messages: My cup is on the table.
Where did I say my cup was?
criteria: Do not present report as camera evidence
Resolve referent from relevant history or ask one concise question

messages: Pause that. Help me find my backpack.
Go back to finding my cup.
I last left it on the sofa.

overall_status: Not accepted: history-to-current location certainty and latency fail actual UI
